rules.refreshSite: (previous RNG + supplied refresh-register operand + supplied carry bit) modulo 256
rules.clockSite: (previous RNG + supplied counter low byte + supplied clock byte) modulo 256

limits: This verifies arithmetic only at the two executed source RNG write sites. The refresh register, carry, counter-low operand, clock and instruction-path-dependent call cadence are supplied by the reference runner. Native gameplay does not generate these inputs or reproduce source randomness autonomously.
